prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of CENOCROCA, a predatory ass-bodied beast with a lion's jaws and chest, ibex horns, a toothless solid-bone mouth and a human voice. Native square PNG at least 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: ONE head, exactly TWO natural eyes, TWO long ridged ibex horns sweeping backward in open arcs, never ram loops. Lion muzzle, jaws and powerful tawny-furred chest joined to a grey donkey torso and rump, donkey hind legs ending in hooves, ONE donkey tail. FOUR quadruped legs total: two lion forelegs and two donkey hind legs, all four distinguishable. TWO ear roots. Mouth split all the way to both ear roots. [cenocroca-c02]
CRITICAL MOUTH: The lower jaw drops steeply DOWN into a deep black vertical gape, not a horizontal smile. The upper and lower biting edges each form a seamless SMOOTH CONTINUOUS IVORY BONE RAIL instead of teeth. ZERO separate teeth, ZERO fangs, ZERO rectangular segments. Clearly visible uninterrupted bone and a dark throat; lips drawn DOWN in a feral calling gape, mouth corners never turned up. [cenocroca-c02]
MOMENT: LUNGE straight toward the viewer from an oblique three-quarter body view, head lowered below shoulders, calling to lure prey. Eyebrows and lids pressed low over two hard fixed pupils glaring straight ahead at camera. Front legs thrust forward, hind hooves driving off the gravel. Its wide slit mouth opens in a deep roaring gape, not a grin. [cenocroca-c03]
POWER: Human-voice imitation is suggested solely by the calling mouth; no visible sound waves or supernatural visual power. Only ordinary gravel and dust displaced by the physical lunge. [cenocroca-c03]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, tight foreshortening; head and lion chest fill most of the foreground, entire donkey rump, hoofed hind legs and single tail visible behind. Animal-sized creature, no giant scaling or human comparators.
LIGHT & WEATHER: NIGHT; one hard low warm side light catches the solid bone rim, horn ridges and narrow glaring eyes; deep walnut black shadows, faint airborne dust. No bright daylight, no glowing eyes.
SURFACE: tangled coarse lion chest fur, bristly grey donkey hair, rugged natural horn ridges, smoothly worn unbroken bone. Anatomical realistic textures, no cartoon exaggeration.
SETTING: minimal unmarked rocky ground disappearing into black; neutral editorial staging because no Cenocroca habitat is documented. No claimed named region, buildings, people or prey.
MOOD: brutally dangerous ambush predator, confronting the viewer; tense jaw muscles, harsh stare and unmistakable attack momentum. Never cute, comic, smiling, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or tails; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or magic fog. The mouth bone is ONE continuous unsegmented material replacing ALL teeth; preserve the ear-to-ear split and sharply lowered jaw.
TARGETED EDIT OF INPUT IMAGE: Keep the violent lunge, cold fixed angry eyes, steeply dropped jaw, full lion chest/donkey rear anatomy, four legs, night lighting and composition. Change only these two details: (1) replace every ivory biting rail with absolutely seamless polished solid ivory, like a smooth continuous anatomical blade: erase ALL regularly spaced grooves, cracks, cuts and any tooth-like divisions. Even at full resolution the entire mouth rim must be uninterrupted blank bone. It replaces teeth. (2) Keep exactly two ibex horns but extend them as long tapering backwards-swept open saber arcs along and behind the skull, no round lateral ram curls and no downward curl around ears. Keep full horn tips in frame. The mouth split still reaches both ear roots. No other changes; no text, gore, glow, extra limbs or stylized comic face.

Redraw at night or dusk with the head lowered in a lunge, the split mouth gaping wide as it calls with a human voice, fixed glaring pupils, the bone ridge lit hard; keep every counted feature.

previous_receipt_with_archive.rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
